lines: So the Crown Supplier finally reaches the fire. About time.
Embercradle was built on strength. We forge or we burn — there's no middle ground in the Horizons.
The corruption here is flame — twisted, consuming. Even our forges run hot with it.
Set up your supply lines, merchant. My people need steel, not speeches.
Shopkeeper. The King has issued new orders.
You are to search for... fragments. Crystalline fragments that predate the corruption.
I asked for clarification. I was told to deliver the message. Nothing more.
I don't like this. But orders are orders. For now.
dialogs.notes: Cedric is beginning to question. First crack in his loyalty.

lines: Four regions cleared. Four puppets toppled.
Does your King tell you why the corruption follows his interests so precisely?
You build well, Shopkeeper. It would be a shame if everything you've built was... temporary.
dialogs.notes: Hooded figure apparition, clearer than before. Knows the Shopkeeper by role. Direct challenge.

lines: I've trained soldiers my whole life. Seen corruption in a dozen forms.
But this — the corruption in each region — it's not random. It's focused.
Like someone is directing it toward specific places.
